source_authored_chapters.title: Object Editing Effects the UV Map

observations: Image Texture assignment and pre-existing primitive UVs are separate.
Smart UV splits by angle; view projection overlaps front/back and collapses edge-on faces.
Cube requires connected cuts; cylinder uses cap rings and longitudinal seam.
UV Rip changes UV connectivity, not skin mesh connectivity.
Nonuniform object scale example is applied then re-unwrapped; not an unconditional instruction for rigged assets.

Newer video in description was not substituted for the requested original.
